reviews.comment: Re-taught myself almost every lecture. She is good, but moves fast. 4 quizzes and she drops the lowest one, 3 exams, 1 cumulative final, attendance points randomly taken, extra credit for asking questions in class. Exams are just super tricky. Almost every question is worded to mess you up.

Kim wants you to succeed but doesn't bend the rules. Her exams are straightforward, you will be prepared if you study. 4 quizzes and she drops the lowest one, 3 exams, 1 final. Quizzes are exactly like the lecture notes/ slides so rework those problems and pay attention in class. I don't recommend her office hours; utilize her TA instead.

Had to tale Acct 327 3 times to pass and finally did with her. She has 75% on tests and rest of quizzes/ attendance. Her lecture notes are bible for her class and you cant succeed without them. Textbook questions don't help for her tests. Very passable class if you study the notes. It simply depends on if you study her notes and understand theory.

Professor Kim is the best for accounting 327! Don't get me wrong this class is not easy, but Professor Kim is kind and willing to help in whatever way she possibly can. Make sure to study for the quizzes, and attend class to understand her powerpoint lectures she uploads to Canvas.

Trust, Kim is the best 327 prof. Compared to my friends with other profs, her exams were the most simple and straightforward. Barely got a C in 229 and have a B in her class. Amazing prof, always eager to help, maybe one of the best profs I've had at mays. Try to take her if you can!!!! So caring! Only thing is your grade is only 4 quizzes 4 exams
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As difficult as the class was, I think an A was feasible as long as you pay attention to her lectures, do all the homework, practice quizzes, and practice exams. She is very straightforward and general in her lectures, so you may need to do some textbook reading on your own to get a better understanding of some materials as needed.

I did poorly because I tanked the first exam. Kim is a really caring professor who is very willing to help. She answered any questions I had, and really wanted us to succeed. Highly recommend for 327.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Kim is a very caring professor who tries to make a very difficult class as easy as she can. Grade is mostly made up of exams/quizzes. It is easy to drop your grade so be sure to stay on top of material and have good study habits for exams/quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: At first I wasn't a huge fan and it was difficult to understand because of accent. However, she is one the most caring professors I've had at Mays. Ask questions outside of class and she will answer it thoroughly. She made a super difficult class doable and I would take her again 100%.

One of the most caring professor who really wants you to succeed. However, sometimes it's hard to understand her sometimes and she does not give homework credit or provide a lot of resources. Overall, this class is just test/quiz heavy so maybe choose a different acct professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Kim was hard to understand at times and her only grades being exams and quizzes did not help at all

Eunjee Kim is the best professor I have had so far at Mays. She explains concepts in the most simple terms possible for complex ideas in accounting. One thing she's really good at is making the students who engage in class feel valued and she makes sure that you're rewarded for trying to learn. Definitely take her class if you can.

Really awesome and understanding professor. I really struggled in this class and she really helped out! You need to buy the textbook and do the suggested problems or you won't pass. A hard class that requires a lot of studying but as long as you put in the effort you will do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: It was her first semester teaching here and it took a couple of weeks to get used to her teaching style, but she is one of the most caring professors I have had. 327 is probably the hardest class you will take so a bunch of people drop, but there was a nice curve at the end of the semester. Definitely a professor I would take again if I could.
